messages:
Ethan (Support): Flagging urgent handoff 1 Peregrine Labs trial tenant can't complete provisioning, getting 403. Ticket #4572. Customer is demoing Friday; AE Lydia asked for priority.
Priya (CS): Acknowledge. I'm taking ownership of customer comms. Can you paste the exact API error and whether provisioning via Console also fails?
Ethan (Support): Error from API: `{"status":403,"msg":"forbidden","detail":"insufficient_key_scope"}`. Console shows "Permission denied" when they click 'Activate trial'.
Lydia (Account Exec): Customer message: "We need this resolved today or we postpone the pilot." Very high growth account.
Nina (Enablement): I can join a screen-share within 20m to walk them. Suggest sending a quick triage email and scheduling 15m now.
Omar (SRE): Quick network note sre-check: no global infra incidents. Looks like auth policy. Ethan, what's the key id?
Ethan (Support): Key id: `k_trial_2026_peregrine`. Trace: `trc-55b2`. I ran a local repro with same key and got 403.
Priya (CS): Proposed comms plan (short):
- Within 15m: send customer note acknowledging, schedule 15m triage, offer workaround (manual console activation).
- Within 60m: run engineer-enabled repro with support and SRE on call.
- If not resolved in 2h: escalate to SEV and propose temporary trial extension + exec note.
Lydia (Account Exec): 👍 include offer of a 2-week free extension if we miss demo. Keep me in loop.
Nina (Enablement): I'll prepare a one-pager we can share during the call: steps, screenshots, known fixes. Link (internal): https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/onboarding/peregrine-quickfix (will sanitize before sending).
Omar (SRE): Possible root: token minted with `read_only` flag by onboarding job. If so fast fix is to mint a scoped key that includes `provision:write` for this tenant. I can approve key issuance during triage.
Ethan (Support): I can generate a test key `k_trial_test_ttl30` when requested. Will not issue to customer directly.
Priya (CS): Customer-facing triage message (draft):
"Hi @Peregrine team, we're on this and have scheduled a 15-minute session. If you can join now, we'll try a manual activation path and share a temporary key for testing. —Priya, Customer Success"

Priya (CS): Action owners: Ethan  reproduce logs + hold console access; Omar  stand by to approve/issue temp key; Nina  host enablement call + one-pager; Priya  lead customer comms + decision on escalation.
provision-bot: policy-check: token `k_trial_2026_peregrine` -> scopes: ["read", "embed"], missing: ["provision:write"].
Ethan (Support): Confirmed repro steps in thread. Will DM customer invite for 15m slot now.
Priya (CS): If triage proves scope issue, plan: issue temp key for repro, then update onboarding job to grant `provision:write` for trial keys (owner: infra oncall). Post-mortem and onboarding doc update assigned to Nina.
Lydia (Account Exec): Please CC me on customer update. If we need to offer extension, I will send the exec note.
Omar (SRE): I'll be on the call in 25m. If we need a code change, we'll open SEV and ping eng-runtime.
Priya (CS): Thanks team. I'll post customer follow-up after the session and assign the postmortem ticket. Keeping this high priority. :white_check_mark:
